---
title: "Validation card"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    toc: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
params:
  result: ""
---

```{r setup}
# The card reads the stored result only. It runs in a fresh R session,
# which may load another bmmtools than the one that made the result, so
# it calls no bmmtools function: everything it prints is a field of the
# result, formatted here.
result <- readRDS(params$result)
plan <- result$plan
info <- as.data.frame(result$run_info)
start <- info[info$when == "start", , drop = FALSE]
end <- info[info$when == "end", , drop = FALSE]
stages <- as.data.frame(result$stages)
verdicts <- as.data.frame(result$verdicts)
numbers <- as.data.frame(result$numbers)
changes <- if (!is.null(result$changes)) as.data.frame(result$changes)

fmt <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(v) {
    if (is.na(v)) "–" else format(signif(v, 3), trim = TRUE)
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
text <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x) | !nzchar(x), "–", as.character(x))
md_table <- function(df) {
  cat("", knitr::kable(df, format = "pipe", row.names = FALSE), "", sep = "\n")
}
# one row per condition, level and term, one column per metric; a value
# with a Monte Carlo standard error carries it in brackets
wide <- function(rows) {
  rows <- rows[rows$metric != "seconds", , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(rows) == 0L) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  rows$cell <- ifelse(
    is.na(rows$mcse), fmt(rows$value),
    paste0(fmt(rows$value), " (", fmt(rows$mcse), ")")
  )
  key <- paste(rows$condition, rows$level, rows$term, sep = "\r")
  first <- !duplicated(key)
  out <- data.frame(
    design = text(rows$condition[first]), level = text(rows$level[first]),
    term = text(rows$term[first])
  )
  for (metric in unique(rows$metric)) {
    at <- rows$metric == metric
    out[[metric]] <- text(rows$cell[at][match(key[first], key[at])])
  }
  # a column with nothing in it is dropped, except the design's and a
  # read-off's, whose dashes say that no design reached the bar
  keep <- vapply(out, function(col) any(col != "–"), logical(1))
  keep[["design"]] <- TRUE
  keep[startsWith(names(out), "n_trials_at_r_low_")] <- TRUE
  out[, keep, drop = FALSE]
}
verdict_word <- function(pass) {
  ifelse(is.na(pass), "not judged", ifelse(pass, "met", "not met"))
}
```

**`r plan$model_name`**: `r result$headline$text`.

The word *validated* means every required stage below met the criterion
printed beside it, under the plan whose version and hash are named here;
it is not a claim about any other plan.

## Run and plan

```{r run}
#| results: asis
md_table(data.frame(
  field = c(
    "Model", "Plan version", "Plan hash", "Defaults", "Owner", "bmm",
    "bmmtools", "brms", "cmdstanr", "CmdStan", "R", "Platform", "CPU",
    "Started", "Seconds"
  ),
  value = text(c(
    plan$model_name, plan$version, plan$hash, plan$defaults, plan$owner,
    start$bmm_version, start$bmmtools_version, start$brms_version,
    start$cmdstanr_version, start$cmdstan_version, start$r_version,
    start$platform, start$cpu_model, format(start$timestamp),
    fmt(end$seconds)
  ))
))
```

The plan's designs, each run `r fmt(plan$reps)` times under the seed
`r fmt(plan$seed)`:

```{r grid}
#| results: asis
md_table(data.frame(
  subjects = fmt(plan$grid$n_subjects), trials = fmt(plan$grid$n_trials)
))
sampler <- plan$sampler
md_table(data.frame(
  setting = names(sampler),
  value = vapply(sampler, function(v) {
    if (is.numeric(v)) fmt(v) else text(paste(v, collapse = ", "))
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
))
```

## Verdicts

```{r verdicts}
#| results: asis
md_table(data.frame(
  stage = verdicts$title,
  required = ifelse(verdicts$required, "yes", "no"),
  status = verdicts$status,
  criterion = verdicts$criterion,
  value = fmt(verdicts$value),
  verdict = ifelse(verdicts$status == "ok", verdict_word(verdicts$pass), "–"),
  note = text(verdicts$note)
))
```

## Stages

```{r stages}
#| results: asis
bar <- plan$criteria$read_off_r_low
# the calibration's prior as the plan stored it, a data frame or a
# brmsprior: unclassed, its columns are read without brms. [[ ]] reads a
# field by its full name, where $ would match `prior_reason` partially
sbc_prior <- plan$sbc[["prior"]]
sbc_reason <- plan$sbc[["prior_reason"]]
prior_table <- function(prior) {
  columns <- unclass(prior)[intersect(
    c(
      "prior", "class", "coef", "group", "resp", "dpar", "nlpar", "lb",
      "ub"
    ),
    names(prior)
  )]
  out <- as.data.frame(
    lapply(columns, function(v) text(as.character(v))),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  keep <- vapply(out, function(col) any(col != "–"), logical(1))
  keep[intersect(c("prior", "class"), names(out))] <- TRUE
  out[, keep, drop = FALSE]
}
# the plan's own prior: its rows and its reason, or the words that none
# was given
prior_rows_lines <- function(whose) {
  cat(
    "\n", whose, ": these rows, in place of bmm's defaults for the",
    " parameters they name.\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  md_table(prior_table(sbc_prior))
  why <- if (is.null(sbc_reason)) {
    "No reason was given for this prior."
  } else {
    sbc_reason
  }
  cat("\n", why, "\n", sep = "")
}
# the calibration's section describes its prior when the calibration was
# planned to run: it ran, or it failed, was skipped or is stale; not when
# it is excluded, not applicable or not built
sbc_status <- stages$status[stages$stage == "sbc"]
sbc_listed <- length(sbc_status) == 1L &&
  sbc_status %in% c("ok", "failed", "skipped", "stale")
# a stale stage's result was made from other inputs, so the plan's prior
# may not be the one it ran under: the card says whose prior it shows
sbc_prior_lines <- function(stale = FALSE) {
  whose <- "The calibration's prior"
  if (stale) {
    cat(
      "\nThis result was made from other inputs or software versions than",
      " the current plan's, so the prior below may not be the one it ran",
      " under.\n",
      sep = ""
    )
    whose <- "The current plan's prior"
  }
  if (is.null(sbc_prior)) {
    cat("\n", whose, ": bmm's default priors.\n", sep = "")
  } else {
    prior_rows_lines(whose)
  }
  cat(
    "\nA calibration speaks for the region of its prior only; the recovery",
    " stage fits under bmm's default priors.\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}
# the set the prior check's verdict is judged under, as
# verdict_prior_predictive() picks it: the calibration's prior when the
# check drew under it, bmm's defaults otherwise; said only when the
# verdict was judged
pp_pass <- verdicts$pass[verdicts$stage == "prior_predictive"]
pp_drew_sbc <- "sbc" %in% unclass(result$prior_predictive)[["prior"]]
judged_under <- if (length(pp_pass) == 0L || all(is.na(pp_pass))) {
  "The draws were not judged; the verdicts table gives the reason."
} else if (pp_drew_sbc) {
  paste0(
    "The verdict is judged on the draws under the calibration's prior",
    # without a section that lists the prior, this one does, below
    if (sbc_listed) " (listed in the calibration's section)",
    "; the draws under bmm's default priors are reported, not judged."
  )
} else {
  "The verdict is judged on the draws under bmm's default priors."
}
reasons <- list(
  prior_predictive = c(plan$prior_check[["range_reason"]], judged_under),
  # D83: the bar is a convention, and the card says so
  data_requirements = if (!is.null(bar)) {
    paste0(
      "The read-off at r_low ", fmt(bar), " is a convention, not a ",
      "finding; the other columns show how the answer moves with the bar. ",
      "The row *all* is the largest read-off over the parameters, and a ",
      "dash means the grid does not reach the bar."
    )
  }
)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(stages))) {
  stage <- stages$stage[[i]]
  cat("\n### ", stages$title[[i]], "\n\n", sep = "")
  status <- stages$status[[i]]
  if (!identical(status, "ok")) {
    why <- text(stages$reason[[i]])
    if (identical(why, "–")) why <- text(stages$message[[i]])
    cat("*", status, "*: ", why, "\n", sep = "")
    # what the calibration was planned under, when it was planned to run:
    # a failed, skipped or stale stage, not one that is excluded, not
    # applicable or not built
    if (identical(stage, "sbc") && sbc_listed) {
      sbc_prior_lines(identical(status, "stale"))
    }
    next
  }
  cat("Ran in ", fmt(stages$seconds[[i]]), " seconds",
    if (isTRUE(stages$resumed[[i]])) ", read from an earlier run",
    ".\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  for (reason in reasons[[stage]]) cat("\n", reason, "\n", sep = "")
  # the prior the check drew under, when no calibration section lists it
  if (identical(stage, "prior_predictive") && pp_drew_sbc && !sbc_listed) {
    prior_rows_lines("The calibration's prior")
  }
  if (identical(stage, "sbc")) sbc_prior_lines()
  table <- wide(numbers[numbers$stage == stage, , drop = FALSE])
  if (!is.null(table)) md_table(table)
}
```

```{r sections}
#| results: asis
if (length(plan$sections) > 0L) {
  cat("\n## Model sections\n")
  for (section in plan$sections) {
    cat("\n### ", section$title, "\n", sep = "")
    if (!is.null(section$numbers)) {
      table <- wide(numbers[numbers$stage == section$numbers, , drop = FALSE])
      if (!is.null(table)) md_table(table)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r changes}
#| results: asis
if (is.null(changes)) {
  cat("\n## Changes\n\nNo earlier result was given, so nothing is compared.\n")
} else {
  moved <- changes[!is.na(changes$moved) & changes$moved, , drop = FALSE]
  cat("\n## Changes since bmm ", attr(result$changes, "old_bmm"), "\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  # the multiplier is the comparison's own, so the sentence cannot
  # state another rule than the one applied
  times <- attr(result$changes, "mcse_multiplier")
  cat(
    nrow(moved), " of ", attr(result$changes, "n_compared"),
    " numbers compared moved by more than ",
    if (!is.null(times)) paste0(fmt(times), " times "),
    "their combined Monte Carlo standard error, or by more than the plan's",
    " tolerance where they have none.\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  if (nrow(moved) > 0L) {
    md_table(data.frame(
      stage = moved$stage, design = text(moved$condition),
      term = text(moved$term), metric = moved$metric, old = fmt(moved$old),
      new = fmt(moved$new), change = fmt(moved$diff)
    ))
  }
}
```
